title: MAC shapes — meta-schema for constraint shape files
description: A shape file declares MAC constraints as data, run by tools/check_shapes.py. This meta-schema makes shape files themselves conformant (MAC's schema-driven discipline applied to its own constraint layer).

target.description: which node kind the shape applies to: concept files (default) or the edges file

where.description: optional target filter — apply only to nodes where each path resolves to the given value (e.g. {concept.class: measure})

path.description: (required/in; optional for rule_binds_grounded/no_predicate_restatement) dotted path; `[]` flattens a list

values.description: (in) the closed set of allowed values

left.description: (subset_of) the path whose values must be a subset

right.description: (subset_of) the path(s) whose union the left must be within

group_by_root.description: (partition) dotted path to the list of grouping rows

group_key.description: (partition) key on each row naming its group — member_key uniqueness holds WITHIN each group, not globally

member_key.description: (partition) key on each row holding the member list that must be unique within the group
